# innertube test fixtures

Fixtures for the offline contract tests (`tests/fixtures_replay.rs`,
`tests/parsers.rs`, `tests/facade_wire.rs`) — the blueprint ch. 15 layer
"innertube contract tests over recorded redacted JSON".

## Provenance

All committed fixtures are **SYNTHETIC**: minimal payloads hand-built to
the structural shape the upstream parsers walk (the field paths named in
the port's doc comments — e.g. `YouTube.kt:1473-1483` for sw.js_data,
`InnerTube.kt:196-201` for visitor_id, the `tabbedSearchResultsRenderer`
spine for search, `MusicResponsiveListItemRenderer` flex/fixed columns
for every list parser). They contain no user data, no real session ids,
and no recordings of YouTube traffic made by this project.

The Phase 05 page fixtures (search, search_suggestions, home, album,
artist, artist_items, playlist, next, queue, history, library, related,
mood_and_genres, explore, new_release_albums, charts, browse_genre,
player_visionos, player_web_remix, account_menu, transcript, timedtext,
ryd_votes, media_info_watch_next) are generated by
`scripts/gen_fixtures.py` (json.dumps guarantees validity) and committed
so the corpus is reviewable in-tree; regenerate with
`python3 scripts/gen_fixtures.py` after editing.

## Recording real captures (opt-in, never in CI)

```
cargo test -p mochy-innertube --features live --test live
```

replays the same flows against the real `music.youtube.com` and
**overwrites** these files with redacted captures (see
`tests/common/mod.rs::redact`): `visitorData`, `onBehalfOfUser`,
`poToken`, `clickTrackingParams`, `trackingParams`, `cpn`,
`authorization`, `cookie` values are replaced with typed placeholders so
parser paths stay exercisable while no real identifier ships in the
repo.

The `live` cargo feature is **never enabled in CI** — the CI matrix runs
plain `cargo test --workspace`, and `tests/live.rs` is compiled out
entirely without the feature. Live tests are for maintainers updating
fixtures after a verified upstream format change.
